description: The file 'CalendarSyncJobCleaner.php' defines a PHP class responsible for managing and cleaning up calendar synchronization jobs within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for cancelling pending meeting jobs that have been superseded by newer synchronization operations, constructs SQL conditions for identifying relevant jobs, and generates descriptive job names based on synchronization data.

classes.name: CalendarSyncJobCleaner
classes.description: A class responsible for cleaning up pending calendar synchronization jobs, particularly for cancelling outdated or superseded jobs related to meeting synchronization operations.

methods.name: cancelPendingMeetingJobs
methods.description: Cancels pending meeting synchronization jobs for a specific CalendarSyncOperation, marking them as failed if they are superseded by a newer operation.

methods.name: getMeetingJobCondition
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition string to identify specific meeting sync jobs associated with a given CalendarSyncOperation.

methods.name: generateMeetingJobName
methods.description: Creates a descriptive job name string based on the CalendarSyncOperation's details, including calendar account ID, location, and event ID.

methods.name: getPendingJobStatusCondition
methods.description: Returns a condition string to filter jobs in the 'queued' state that are not deleted, used to identify pending jobs.
